beta_elapsed_soak.required: 90 consecutive days and three operational cycles
beta_elapsed_soak.observed: one observation and one cycle identifier
beta_elapsed_soak.reset_rule: any cadence break, revision change or failed restoration resets the clock

rc_elapsed_soak.required: 30 days on one frozen release-candidate revision

external_user_workflows.required: two distinct external-user workflows with environment, deviations and findings

accountable_release_authority.required: signed tier-specific decision with scope, exclusions, expiry, rollback and revocation conditions

stable_release_approval.required: all v1 gates, signed/attested/preserved artifacts and release-authority approval
stable_release_approval.promotion: forbidden until every blocking gate has qualifying evidence

non_substitution_rule: Agent panels, local tests, hosted technical previews and synthetic fixtures cannot create elapsed time, participant facts, accountable signatures or stable-release approval.
next_actions: Continue the protected-main beta ledger without resetting its exact revision or cadence contract.
Freeze a release candidate only after upstream implementation and evidence gates pass, then start a new 30-day exact-head clock.
Collect two factual external-user workflow records and attach immutable reports.
Obtain and preserve the accountable authority's signed decision before any promotion or announcement.
